_about: Hand-checked layer on top of the census. Keys are contract ids. Every entry comes from the preservation-risk write-up (13 Oct 2026, updated late evening) or the 16 Oct re-test notes; nothing here is new evidence. 'status' overrides the census bucket only where the hand check says the bucket misleads. 'helper' is a hint as of its date: the page must read live twin counts from chain (Phase 2).

retest.scope: Every collection the census put in Lost, Failing or Walking dead (34) was re-tested through its own contract on 16 Oct 2026 and still failed. Marketplace results matched 13 Oct except the two below.

SP3D6PV2ACBPEKYJTCMH7HEN02KP87QSP8KTEH33.name: Megapont Robots
SP3D6PV2ACBPEKYJTCMH7HEN02KP87QSP8KTEH33.summary: The contract points to Megapont's own API. The API still answers, but it no longer serves metadata or images, and the marketplace tiles are blank. We haven't found a public copy of the art.
SP3D6PV2ACBPEKYJTCMH7HEN02KP87QSP8KTEH33.evidence: Checked 13 Oct 2026 through the contract and through Gamma's image copy (0 of 16 loaded), and by eye on Gamma's collection page.

SPJW1XE278YMCEYMXB8ZFGJMH8ZVAAEDP2S2PJYG.name: Blocks
SPJW1XE278YMCEYMXB8ZFGJMH8ZVAAEDP2S2PJYG.headline: The contract's link is dead and most marketplace tiles are blank, but the full set of images still sits in one Pinata IPFS folder.
SPJW1XE278YMCEYMXB8ZFGJMH8ZVAAEDP2S2PJYG.summary: The contract points at one stacksart.com file that no longer works. Gamma's index sends most tokens to a dead storage bucket, but 249 records point at an IPFS folder that appears to hold all 2,500 images. Only Pinata answered for that folder.
SPJW1XE278YMCEYMXB8ZFGJMH8ZVAAEDP2S2PJYG.evidence: Gateway fetches, Gamma's full index and the 13 Oct census. We have not confirmed the folder is the artist's original set.

helper.note: Helper type decided (large files, on demand); not built.

SP3QSAJQ4EA8WXEDSRRKMZZ29NH91VZ6C5X88FGZ.summary: The marketplace's images were stored on a Cloudinary account that has since been disabled, and on Gaia links (Hiro's hosted Gaia hub, which went offline on 16 June 2025).
SP3QSAJQ4EA8WXEDSRRKMZZ29NH91VZ6C5X88FGZ.evidence: Re-tested 16 Oct 2026: 0 of 16 marketplace images loaded; Cloudinary returns HTTP 401 'cloud_name chemical-x is disabled'; Gaia links fail with a network error.
